sourceBasis.title: Set up payment terms - Business Central
usedFor: Payment terms manage due dates and payment discounts.
Payment terms can be assigned to customers and vendors and flow to sales and purchase documents.
Document dates are used to calculate due dates; document-level terms can be changed without changing the customer default.

sourceBasis.title: Table Payment Terms
usedFor: Relevant fields include Code, Due Date Calculation, Discount Date Calculation, Discount %, Description and Calc. Pmt. Disc. on Cr. Memos.

sourceBasis.title: DateFormula data type
usedFor: Date formulas are stored in a generic format and displayed for the current language.
30D is the product-source example for 30 days; the later German UI proof must verify the displayed localized value.

selectedPaymentTerm.expectedLocalizedDisplay: 30T or equivalent German localized display after save/reopen
selectedPaymentTerm.businessReason: A simple 30-day net term is realistic for a first B2B customer scenario, easy to explain in training, and sufficient to prove due-date logic before adding discounts, installments or special collection rules.
selectedPaymentTerm.trainingReason: Finance and sales users can understand invoice date, due date and overdue monitoring before learning discounts or reminders.
selectedPaymentTerm.uatReason: A later UAT scenario can create or preview a sales invoice and verify that the due date is calculated 30 days after the document date, once O2C setup is otherwise ready.
